# init

Writes the project config, the memory file and a git exclude. Safe to run again.

```
centcom init [--yes] [--force] [--dry-run]
```

## Options

- `--yes`: accept the defaults without asking
- `--force`: overwrite what is there
- `--dry-run`: show what would change and change nothing
